text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: …I have a trainer.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: He's so kind, like the big brother in my book. He took my hand even though I'm so useless…

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: She's so kind, like the big sister in my book. She took my hand even though I'm so useless…

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: That's why I decided I want to become a blue rose.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I want to be a wonderful person who brings happiness wherever they go, not a useless girl who just brings misfor—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Ah, it's almost time for training…

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: …A little jogging beforehand can't hurt.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Hehe… Rice Shower enters the starting gate, the crowd cheering her name—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Hyaaa!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Hyaaa?!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Pant… pant…

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: And that's another new record, Bourbon! Looks like the star of the Classics this year is already decided!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Wow… that was really incredible. Hey, Bourbon! Would you mind talking—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: My regimen is not yet complete. Excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Students
text_block_list.text: Hyaaaaa! She's so cool!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: …Incredible. I can't believe so many people came to the track to see her.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: If I run now, I'll probably just get in the way.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Rice Shower and I begin working towards the Twinkle Series today!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I head to our rendezvous location, my heart swelling with anticipation.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: …But she isn't here.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There's still five minutes until our meetup time. As long as she makes it to practice by then, it'll be fine.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: …But she never arrives.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I furrow my brow. The fact that she hasn't contacted me yet means something is definitely wrong. Where in the world could she be?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Wh-what should I do? Training time must be over by now… Sigh…

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huh?! What are you doing he—oh…

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I-I'm sorry I wasn't able to get to practice on time!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I-I went for a run… but there were roadworks on the path I usually take.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: So I tried a different route, but I got lost… and then I got held up by every single traffic light…

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Sniffle… And now it's already this late…
choice_data_list: It's fine. I'm just glad you're okay.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I-it's not fine!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Because of me, all the time you put into preparing today's training was for nothing…

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: So… if it's all right with you…

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: P-please tell me everything that we were going to do today…

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I don't want to be useless like this forever… I'll train on my own!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I-is that a no? Right, I bet that's even more trouble…

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huh?!
choice_data_list: You don't have to practice alone. Let's do it together!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Really?! O-okay!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: …And so, Rice Shower and I begin our journey to take on the Twinkle Series.
